reason: The cited evidence supports that HEAs can be single-phase and strengthened by lattice strain (E2), and that Cr addition promotes a protective Al2O3/Cr2O3 layer with improved oxidation and corrosion resistance (E3). However, no cited passage addresses lightweight base elements (Al, Ti, V, Nb) forming a single-phase with Cr/Cu, nor the specific trade-off between density, strength, and environmental resistance in a single alloy, leaving key premises about the balanced lightweight composition unsupported.
